state.objective: Review unresolved loan, lease and exception families and define evidence-dependent dispositions so every client COA family has a reviewed status.
confirmed_context: One PT Perorangan owns all sites; no permanent HO-unit affiliate receivables/payables are required.
No foreign currency, overdraft or pledged deposits exist.
Bank identity belongs in bank_account_id/facility_id; site association and HO-only access are separate concerns.
Final migration decisions still require contracts, policies, transaction samples and reconciled balances.

remaining_patterns.current_maturity_loans_6: Principal plus five named-bank PJP Jatuh Tempo families.
remaining_patterns.long_term_loans_6: Principal plus five named-bank long-term loan families.
remaining_patterns.principal_site_14: Other Payable Principal repeated for HO and 13 sites; creditor is unknown.
asset_exceptions: HGB/Land Right cost and accumulated amortization

current_bank_loans.instructions: Can five named-bank current-maturity loan families become one Current Maturities of Bank Loans GL with facility_id?

criteria.conditional: Yes after facility schedules and maturity reconciliation.
criteria.retain5: Bank name must remain in GL.

long_bank_loans.instructions: Can five named-bank long-term loan families become one Long-term Bank Loans GL with facility_id?

criteria.conditional: Yes after contracts and schedules reconcile.
criteria.retain5: Bank name must remain in GL.

current_long_separate.instructions: Must current maturities and long-term portions remain separate presentation natures?

criteria.yes: Keep current and noncurrent natural accounts with scheduled reclassification.
criteria.one: Use one loan GL regardless of maturity.

principal_in_bank.instructions: Can Principal-labelled current and long-term families be merged into bank loans without identifying the creditor?

principal_site.instructions: Given one legal entity, may 14 site-labelled Principal liabilities reduce to one creditor/facility control if evidence proves the same external owner/lender obligation?

criteria.conditional: Yes, site identity moves to site/use-of-funds detail and creditor/facility controls the liability.

interest_two.instructions: Should bank-loan and leasing interest expenses be merged automatically?

criteria.review: Financing type, lease accounting and reporting may justify separate natures; facility_id supplies identity.

lease_four.instructions: Can four lease/rent expense families be finalized before contract-by-contract lease/land-right assessment?

criteria.no: Classify short-term/low-value expense, ROU depreciation/interest, land rights and service components first.
criteria.one: Merge all to rent expense immediately.

hgb.instructions: Can HGB/Land Right cost and accumulated amortization be finalized from labels alone?

criteria.no: Review legal right, term, renewal, ownership and accounting policy.

preopening.instructions: Can Pre-opening and accumulated amortization remain as an asset merely because legacy accounts exist?

criteria.no: Test recognition policy and postings; reclassify prospectively/auditably as required.

cip.instructions: Can Contract In Progress be assigned without knowing whether it is construction of own asset or customer contract?

criteria.no: Inspect contract/project and posting flows; keep provisional separate control.

disposed_inventory.instructions: Can Disposed Inventory be finalized without transaction evidence?

criteria.no: Determine inventory disposal, fixed-asset disposal, clearing or loss nature from entries.

reserve_oe.instructions: Can 36 Reserve Replacement OE families become one control account if postings prove one common balance-sheet nature and item names are detail?

criteria.conditional: Yes only after identifying contra-asset/provision/other nature and reconciling roll-forward.
criteria.retain36: Every item type must remain GL.

damage_expense.instructions: Should inventory damage expense remain conditional on whether an allowance is used?

criteria.yes: Posting model determines direct loss versus allowance utilization and expense recognition.

cogs_purchase.instructions: Should Purchase Cost/COGS and Purchase Discount remain conditional on periodic/perpetual method?

criteria.yes: Inventory method and closing flow determine mapping.

tax_exception.instructions: Should Current Tax Inc/Exp PPh25 remain exception status until entries and tax returns separate expense, installment/credit, payable and true-up?

criteria.yes: Split by actual nature before migration.

mixed_income_expense.instructions: Should Other Income (Expense) be split by transaction nature rather than retained as a mixed account?

criteria.yes: Map each posting to controlled income or expense nature.

current_profit.instructions: Should Current-month Profit/Loss be system-derived and legacy manual balances reconciled before deactivation?

criteria.yes: Use closing engine and retained-earnings roll-forward.

grni.instructions: Should Supplier Suspend remain a controlled GRNI/unmatched-receipt account until PO-GRN-invoice matching clears it?

criteria.yes: Keep distinct with aging and reconciliation.
criteria.ap: Merge unmatched amounts into confirmed AP.

coverage_claim.instructions: When every family is assigned approved, conditional, retain, deactivate-after-reclass, or unresolved-evidence status, is it valid to say every family was reviewed even though some final mappings await client evidence?

criteria.yes: Review coverage is complete, while migration approval remains conditional for documented exceptions.
criteria.no: A family cannot be reviewed unless evidence already resolves it.

final_count.instructions: Can a single defensible final COA count be claimed before all documented evidence gates are resolved?

criteria.no: Report a recommended conditional target plus conservative range and unresolved gates.
criteria.yes: Choose the smallest count regardless of evidence.
